name: robots/generalroboticslab__dukehumanoidhardwarecontrol
title: Duke Humanoid V1 (biped_controller.BipedController)
intro: Duke Humanoid V1 (biped_controller.BipedController), adapted from generalroboticslab/dukehumanoidhardwarecontrol. It reads `joint_positions`, `joint_velocities`, `joint_currents`, `dof_position_target` and 6 more; sets `command_forward`, `command_lateral` and `command_yaw`; runs `control_step` and `halt`. `control_step`: run one closed-loop control step: update the command, refresh the observation, compute the policy action and write the motor target. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
